pairs.subject: docs-content-model
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/DocTabs.tsx:74 The 'docs' here are one character package's own markdown files (constitution.md, bible.md, rules/<id>.md), served by the daemon as plain string fields of CharacterDetail and shown in an operator console. There is no published documentation catalog with category/topic records, body map, sitemap or search index. A search of the context's directory for sitemap, topic, catalog, lastReviewed and checked_against found nothing. ('draft' does appear, but only as Tone Lab line drafts, which are unrelated.)

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/PackagePage.tsx:27 Each package's prose arrives inside one RPC detail object. No topic table is split from a lazily loaded body map, so there is no record-to-body mapping to assert.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/routes.ts:8 The tab list is a fixed set of view types over one package's fields (constitution, rules, bible, and so on). It is not a navigation list over a topic catalog that could drift.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/PackagePage.tsx:30 The only filter is role-based: the Moderation tab shows only on the moderator's package. It has nothing to do with draft readiness, and the address still resolves, rendering an explanatory EmptyState instead of a 404.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/DocTabs.tsx:21 The constitution body is a bare markdown string field. There is no topic record that could carry review date, checked-against version or watched-sources fields.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/packageDocs.ts:101 Package documents define the character's behaviour. They do not describe product features located elsewhere, so there is no product area to map.
